_README.description: Model metadata for Anthropic's Claude API (direct Messages API access).
_README.usage: Models listed here are exposed directly through the native Anthropic provider (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY). Aliases are case-insensitive. Claude models are also reachable via OpenRouter (anthropic/... IDs); when both an Anthropic key and OpenRouter are configured, the native Anthropic provider wins by priority so bare aliases like 'opus'/'fable' route direct.

field_descriptions.model_name: The Anthropic Messages API model identifier (e.g., 'claude-opus-5')
field_descriptions.aliases: Array of short names users can type instead of the full model name
field_descriptions.context_window: Total number of tokens the model can process (input + output combined)
field_descriptions.max_output_tokens: Maximum number of tokens the model can generate in a single response
field_descriptions.max_thinking_tokens: Maximum reasoning/thinking tokens when extended thinking is requested (Anthropic budget_tokens; clamped to >=1024 and < max_output_tokens at call time)
field_descriptions.supports_extended_thinking: Whether the model supports Anthropic extended thinking (reasoning) budgets
field_descriptions.supports_json_mode: Whether the model can guarantee valid JSON output
field_descriptions.supports_function_calling: Whether the model supports tool use
field_descriptions.supports_images: Whether the model can process image input
field_descriptions.max_image_size_mb: Maximum total size in MB for all images combined
field_descriptions.supports_temperature: Whether the model accepts a temperature parameter (forced to 1.0 by the API when extended thinking is enabled)
field_descriptions.temperature_constraint: Type of temperature constraint: 'fixed', 'range', 'discrete', or omit for default range
field_descriptions.default_reasoning_effort: Default reasoning effort level for models that support it
field_descriptions.intelligence_score: 1-20 human rating used as the primary signal for auto-mode model ordering. Since 2026-10-13 it is anchored to the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v4.3 at HIGH reasoning effort (aa_index_by_effort['high'], leaderboard read 2026-10-12/13) through the ladder in docs/model_ranking.md. Entries without aa_index_by_effort carry estimated scores. PAL tools default to thinking_mode medium, so a typical call can score a few Index points below the anchor.
field_descriptions.aa_index: Optional AA Index value behind intelligence_score at the high-effort anchor (interpolated or estimated where AA has no high row; the description says which). Used to order models that share the same intelligence_score.
field_descriptions.aa_index_by_effort: Optional per-effort Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index values (v4.3 leaderboard, read 2026-10-12), keyed by effort (non-reasoning, low, medium, high, xhigh, max; 'default' for a model with a single row). Values AA marks as incomplete (*) are left out.
field_descriptions.effort_levels: Optional list of reasoning-effort levels this route accepts. When set, PAL sends the tool's thinking_mode as an explicit effort, clamped to these levels; when absent, no effort is sent.
field_descriptions.allow_code_generation: Whether this model can generate fully working code for your AI tool to use right away. Only true for a model more capable than the AI model / CLI you're currently using.

models.description: Anthropic flagship (1M context, released 2026-09-22) - Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index 58 at max effort, above Fable 5.1 (53); at or above Fable 5.1 on most work for $4/$20, a fifth below Opus 5. The API default effort is Medium, which scores 51.
Anthropic flagship (1M context) - Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index 51, superseded by Opus 5.5; deep reasoning, architecture, agentic coding.
Previous-generation Opus (1M context, 128K output) - adaptive thinking with effort levels; estimated score, superseded by Opus 5.

Anthropic Mythos-class model (1M context) - tops the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index at 53 (max effort), ahead of Opus 5 (51) and Fable 5 (50); autonomous long-horizon coding and knowledge work. Premium pricing ($10/$50).
Anthropic Mythos-class model (1M context) - AA Intelligence Index 50, superseded by Fable 5.1; autonomous long-horizon knowledge work and coding. Premium pricing ($10/$50).

Claude Sonnet 5.5 (released 2026-09-28, 1M context, 128K output) - AA Intelligence Index 56 at max effort, above Fable 5.1 (53) and below Opus 5.5 (58). $2/$10 per M. Adaptive thinking, default effort high.
Most capable Sonnet tier (1M context) - near-Opus intelligence for coding and agentic work at Sonnet cost; adaptive thinking. Superseded by Sonnet 5.5.
Legacy Sonnet (200K context, 64K output) - extended thinking with a token budget, no effort parameter; estimated score.

Claude Haiku 5.5 (released 2026-10-07, 1M context, 128K output) - small, fast tier for high-volume work; AA Intelligence Index 43 at max effort (38 at high). From $0.10/$0.50 per M. Adaptive thinking, default effort medium. Succeeds Haiku 4.5.
Fast, low-cost Claude tier (200K context) - quick analysis and high-volume work; supports thinking.
